The '''Phelleem sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], rimward of [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Phelleem included [[Kashi]] and [[Naldar]].

==History==
After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] tasked [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Flint]] to conquer the entire Phelleem sector while she prepared the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Nagai–Tof War|invasion]] of the galaxy.<ref name="ENDTSD">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref><ref name="TFW">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref>
